二锅头+雪花+红牛，混在一起喝会怎样？
“咯咯咯！”
齐知玄迷迷糊糊的醒来，听到了鸡打鸣声。
好奇怪，城市里哪来的鸡？
下一秒，他突然感觉到浑身上下哪哪都疼，肠胃一阵剧烈抽搐。
巨饿！
“我怎么这么饿啊，昨晚还吃了火锅……”
齐知玄张开眼皮，瞳孔逐渐聚焦。
首先映入眼帘的是长头发，蓬头垢面那种。
“噫！！”
齐知玄顿时懵逼了，可怜他只是蓝星上一个为了老板的幸福生活而努力工作的社畜牛马，房贷压力巨大，头发都快愁秃完了，哪来的长头发？
“呃，一定是我还在做梦。”
齐知玄努力让自己清醒过来，却是头痛欲裂，记忆混乱。
只想起昨晚公司聚会，自己正在陪老板唱着歌吃着火锅，喝了一杯同事递过来的酒，然后就感觉一阵天旋地转，眼底的画面都开始扭曲，各种形状、颜色炸裂开来。
齐知玄摇了摇脑袋，伸手去摸手机，却发现自己正躺在……
一堆干草上面？？
一股霉味。
滂臭！
齐知玄愕然抬头，可以看出自己身处一间狭小简陋的茅草屋，角落里堆放着很多木柴，旁边还有一个只有在农村才能够见到的烧火灶台。

“这，这是哪里？”
齐知玄忍着疼痛坐起来，一看。
他身上竟然穿着打满补丁的破麻衣，如同乞丐一般。
还有，他的啤酒肚没有了，身材变得单薄，细胳膊瘦腿的。
“这是我的身体？”齐知玄彻底惊呆了，狠狠掐了下大腿。
也就在这时，一段不属于他的记忆突然冲击他的脑海，让头疼瞬间达到高潮。
片刻后，大喘粗气的齐知玄终于弄清楚发生了什么。
勒个去！
穿越了！
原身所在的这个世界非常类似于古代，却不是人类已知的任何一个朝代和地域，气候环境也不同，风俗习惯更是迥异。
“原身名叫赵大虎，家住白石村，世代贫农，一贫如洗。”
“六岁死了娘，七岁父亲续弦，后妈尖酸刻薄，动辄打骂虐待，不给饭吃，导致他体弱多病，加上昨晚又挨了一顿毒打，没挺过去，一命呜呼，终年十七岁。”
齐知玄嘴角一阵抽搐。
好家伙！
早死的妈，凉薄的爸，恶毒的后妈……

What will happen if you mix Erguotou + Snowflake + Red Bull together?
"Giggle!"
Qi Zhixuan woke up in a daze and heard the crow of roosters.
How strange, where do chickens come from in the city?
The next second, he suddenly felt pain everywhere in his body, and his stomach and intestines twitched violently.
Very hungry!
"Why am I so hungry? I had hot pot last night..."
Qi Zhixuan opened his eyelids and his pupils gradually focused.
The first thing that catches the eye is the long, unkempt hair.
"Hey!!"
Qi Zhixuan was stunned. It was pity that he was just a social beast on Blue Star who worked hard for his boss's happy life. He was under huge mortgage pressure and his hair was almost bald. Where did he get long hair?
"Well, I must still be dreaming."
Qi Zhixuan tried hard to wake up, but he had a splitting headache and confused memory.
I just remembered last night's company party. I was singing and eating hot pot with my boss. I drank a glass of wine handed over by my colleague. Then I felt the world spinning. The picture in my eyes began to distort, and various shapes and colors exploded.
Qi Zhixuan shook his head and reached out to touch his phone, only to find that he was lying...
On top of a pile of hay? ?
A musty smell.
Stinky!
Qi Zhixuan looked up in shock and could see that he was in a small and simple thatched house. There were a lot of firewood piled in the corner, and next to it was a stove that could only be seen in rural areas.
"W-where is this?"
Qi Zhixuan endured the pain and sat up to take a look.
He was actually wearing tattered linen clothes that were patched all over, like a beggar.
Also, his beer belly is gone, his figure has become thinner, his arms and legs are thin.
"Is this my body?" Qi Zhixuan was completely shocked and pinched his thigh hard.
At this moment, a memory that did not belong to him suddenly hit his mind, causing his headache to reach its climax in an instant.
After a while, Qi Zhixuan, who was breathing heavily, finally figured out what happened.
Go ahead!
Time traveled!
The world where the original body is located is very similar to ancient times, but it is not from any dynasty or region known to mankind. The climate and environment are also different, and the customs and habits are even more different.
"My original name is Zhao Dahu. I live in Baishi Village. I have been a poor farmer for generations. I am impoverished."
"My mother died when I was six, and my father remarried me when I was seven. My stepmother was harsh and harsh. She often beat, scolded, abused, and refused to feed him, which made him weak and sick. In addition, he received another severe beating last night, but he couldn't survive it. He died at the age of seventeen."
The corners of Qi Zhixuan's mouth twitched.
Good guy!
A mother who died young, a cold father, a vicious stepmother...
